newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PSG TUMBLE TO FIRST DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSG TUMBLE TO FIRST DEFEAT.

text.p: Stephane Guivarc'h, top scorer in the French first division, struck twice for Rennes in 11 minutes on Friday to send leaders Paris Saint-Germain crashing 2-1, their first league defeat of the season.
Monaco crushed Lille 4-1 away and champions Auxerre thrashed 10-man Lyon 7-0 at home to throw the title race wide open.
Lyon defender Florent Laville was sent off in the 45th minute with the score 1-0.
Monaco, who have scored four goals in each of their last three matches, ended Lille's unbeaten home record as they climbed to just three points behind PSG in second place.
Auxerre, whose Algerian midfielder Moussa Saib struck twice, are third, one point further behind.
Once-mighty Marseille slumped to their second successive home defeat, 1-0 to Nantes, and were jeered off by their own fans.
